phases.deliverable: General effect/representation/call/view IR; GC/poll/deopt/frame metadata; explicit lowered code-growth budgets fixed before measurement
phases.gate: Machine-checkable unsupported/stale-certificate rejection and generated-code metadata reports; no semantic claims from VOP names alone

phases.deliverable: Existing primitive access lowered through checked storage views and general copy/fill kernels; no new hand-written native helper just for speed
phases.gate: Differential Emacs semantic suite plus forced-GC/error/interrupt negative controls and end-to-end workloads

phases.deliverable: Generic callee certificates, binding version checks, post-lowering guarded cost decisions
phases.gate: Non-benchmark callee corpus, code-growth and frame/root budgets, same-N GNU/OLD/NEW alternating fresh-process timing and allocations; reject primary regression

limitations: No speed promise; no timings rerun.
No complete SBCL backtrace/root-map ABI audit; frame and safepoint anchors constrain design, do not establish binary compatibility.
